summary: Design GenAI policies, risk reviews, and approval controls. Build practical governance artefacts in this five-day course. Explore the outline.
lede: Generative AI governance training helps enterprise AI, risk, compliance and digital leaders design practical controls for workplace use. Participants practise creating use-case registers, risk assessments and approval workflows, then define acceptable-use rules, human-review checkpoints and audit records to support accountable decisions. The course also covers risk treatment and oversight reporting, with exercises to develop governance tools suited to an organization’s operating model.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, review, or operate enterprise generative AI policies and controls.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with organizational AI use, risk management, compliance, or policy processes is recommended. No coding or model-development experience is required.
